verdict.rationale: Missive documents rules and automations, including multi-step rules and up to 1000 rules, so this axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence shows rule versioning, change review, or rollback to a prior rule version. The general activity log ('every action within Missive is logged') is an adjacent audit feature, not automation version control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
